# Hock Chuan Hiong 福荃香肉乾至尊

> Hock Chuan Hiong 福荃香肉乾至尊 is a bak kwa (Chinese dried meat) shop in Bandar Bukit Tinggi 1, Klang, Selangor, Malaysia, with roots at a stall in Pandamaran. Non-Halal (pork products). Retail walk-in and in-store pickup, festive gift boxes (Chinese New Year, Mooncake Festival) and wholesale orders.

- Address: 40-00-01, Lorong Batu Nilam 1D, Bandar Bukit Tinggi 1, 41200 Klang, Selangor, Malaysia
- WhatsApp and phone: +60 10-234 9328 (https://wa.me/60102349328)
- Email: hchiongfood@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 9am to 8pm
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hock+Chuan+Hiong+%E7%A6%8F%E8%8D%83%E9%A6%99%E8%82%89%E4%B9%BE%E8%87%B3%E5%B0%8A/@3.0096117,101.437707,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x31cdad9274a974c3:0x9015173573fe23a0
- Google rating: 4.6 from 125 reviews (Google Business Profile, 20 Nov 2026)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hchiongfood
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hockchuanhiongfood/
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@hockchuanhiongfood
- Non-Halal: pork products.

## Products
- Pork bak kwa (猪肉乾)
- Sliced pork bak kwa (切片肉乾)
- Gold coin bak kwa (金钱肉乾)
- Chicken bak kwa (鸡肉乾)
- Pork floss (猪肉丝)
- Chicken floss (鸡肉丝)
- Dong Po bacon (东坡肉)
- Bak kwa roti (猪肉乾面包)
